title: crataegus collina var. sordida
intro: Crataegus collina var. sordida, commonly known as a type of hawthorn plant, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used to support cardiovascular health due to its potential health benefits, including reducing blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus collina var. sordida include cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular herbal remedy for various cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
